glosses: Meaningless or content-free chatter in a discussion; drivel, babble.

word_linkages.word: all my eye and Betty Martin

examples.text: Now his fingertips were tapping in addition to his toe-bouncing, until soon his entire body was wibbling in jumping-bean fashion. “Old Mag, you say?” He peered around Nitty at Mag, and Mag took the opportunity to inspect his mask and goggles with her trunk. The boy quit wibbling, stood stock-still, and gulped.
